values.intro: Pick a topic to read the short answer.

tabs.label: Planting
tabs.content:
Most gardens are planted between October and March, while the soil is workable and the plants are dormant.

Bare-root stock

Hedging and fruit trees go in as bare roots, which costs less and establishes faster.

tabs.label: Maintenance
tabs.content:
We cut lawns, clip hedges and feed beds every fortnight from April to October.

  • Mowing and edging
  • Weeding of beds
